{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Mage Council]] |location_page_description = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to discuss stolen research. |x = -121.5 |y = 82 |z = -756.5 |location2 = [[Burning Desert]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to find the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x2 = -526.5 |y2 = 86 |z2 = -885.5 |location3 = [[Crimson Isle]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] next to the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x3 = -522.86 |y3 = 104 |z3 = -918.8 |minimap_location3 = Burning Desert |location4 = The Wasteland |location_page_description4 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]]. |x4 = -373.5 |y4 = 117 |z4 = -977.5 |location5 = Forgotten Skull |location_page_description5 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] after defeating [[Kuudra]]. |x5 = -373.5 |y5 = 113 |z5 = -1036.5 }} '''Captain Ahone''' is an [[NPC]] found throughout the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} primarily during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], as well as at the end of both [[Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questlines]]. == Quest == '''Captain Ahone''' first appears during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] when the player is sent to the {{Zone|Mage Council}} to meet about stolen research. Later in the quest, he appears in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} with a {{Item|Small Backpack}}, after {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with finding the lost {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. Their [[Abiphone]] contact gets added to the player's Abiphone, instructing them to call upon finding the Apprentice. When this happens, he then walks up to the Apprentice with {{NPCSprite|Grelius}} and {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, splashes him with healing potions, and then disappears, tasking the player player with reporting back to {{NPCSprite|Dean}}. Towards the end of the quest, {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with calling Captain Ahone, who then instructs the player to meet them by the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}. He can then be found there with several other [[NPCs]], who all agree to investigate [[Kuudra]]. This ending also occurs at the end of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. After defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time as part of either quest, they then appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, disappearing after you continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" | During the {{Zone|Mage Council}} meeting | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: Oh, &7 &fis here! [[File:Cult of the Fallen Star Screenshot.png|thumb|290x290px|The cult in the game]]
The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is a secret cult found in the {{zone|Cliffside Veins}} in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} at {{Coordinates|-45|193|45}}. To find the cult, players need to arrive between 0 AM and 6 AM in-game time on either the 7th, 14th, 21st or 28th day of each SkyBlock month. The entrance to the cult's cave is at {{Coordinates|-26|198|40}}. After going to a meeting, the player will obtain the {{ach|The Cult of the Fallen Star|ach=true}}.

After speaking to {{NPCSprite|Brarnas}} for the first time, players will be given the [[Fallen Star Helmet]]. In subsequent meetings with the cult, when the player wears the [[Fallen Star Helmet]], they will receive {{Item|Starfall|amount=200}}.

[[Silnar]] is also a member of the '''Cult''', who gives the player a [[Fallen Star Lozenge]].

== Location ==
The cult's cave is located in a hidden area of {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}; specifically, it is west of the purple crystal and up the cliff. Players can use the lava channel in the {{Zone|Lava Springs}} to access the location without having to use ender pearls.

|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!

&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You said you never even saw the plates.

&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: No I didn't.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Anyways!

&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Cat again?

== Trivia ==
*Meetings, except for the gap between the meetings on the 28th and the 7th, are 7 in-game days apart (2 hours and 20 minutes in real life time).
*'''Dalir''' is the only cult member players can interact with.
*Despite the message saying "come back next time" if you forget to wear the helmet, you can simply put on the helmet and then talk to Brarnas again to receive the {{Item|Starfall}}.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is likely the antithesis to the [[Armor of the Rising Sun|Rising Sun]] as they share the same naming scheme.
*There is a [[Fairy Soul]] at {{Coords|-52|205|48}}, which is accessed from their room.
*'''Thondin''' states that his favourite food is blue pizza during cult meeting #6.
**The red and blue pizzas are a reference to [[w:The Matrix|The Matrix]]'s red pill and blue pill, where the red pill represents learning an unsettling truth, and the blue pill represents remaining in comfortable ignorance.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' members are one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], [[Oen]], [[Yoshua]], and [[Skylark]].

I made a &ccritical&f discovery, which MUST remain confidential. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: I entrusted a letter containing my findings to &cLathrop&f for delivery. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: As the letter never reached the wizard, I had &eAlatar&f summon an exact copy of it. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: I threw the letter into the &5breach&f, which broke the laws of causality. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: I &einstantly&f appeared here, &bshattered&f by my boneheaded decision-making and &deternally trapped&f. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: But I've been continuing my research. &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: &oYou're &fpart of it. &eSelect an option: &a[Yes. That is not weird at all.] }} |- | class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Yes. That is not weird at all.]}} |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: May you lead a fulfilling life!}} |- | class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: It's you again. &eSelect an option:&a [Open your shop]&7 [I have a few questions...] }} |} == Lore == === Story === After the [[Calamity|{{DarkRed|Calamity}}]] took the life of [[Lathrop]]'s parents, '''Dr. Emmett''' adopted him. He was interested in studying [[The Breach]] that also came from the Calamity. One day, over thirty years after the Calamity, he asked Lathrop to deliver a letter with details regarding his experiment to his colleague in the {{Zone|Wilderness}}. The letter however, was never delivered, since Lathrop went to {{Red|The Catacombs}} with [[Necron]] and became [[The Watcher]]. Since Lathrop never delivered the letter, '''Dr. Emmett''' asked [[Alatar]] to summon a copy of it. He threw the letter into the breach, which caused an event that transformed him into the [[Rift Dimension]], to be forever stuck there. He continues his study from inside of the [[Rift]] as the first human to enter this dimension, unfortunately he is forever stuck there. == Trivia == *'''Dr. Emmett''' is one of a few NPCs who are not originally from [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Julian}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Alatar}} and {{NPCSprite|Tel Kar}}. *'''Dr. Emmett''' and [[The Watcher]]'s names are references to Dr. Emmett Lathrop Brown, also known as Doc, from ''Back to the Future'': in the lore, The Watcher's original name was Lathrop. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2023/May 4|[[File:Dr. Emmett.png|26px]] Added '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} |beta= {{History|2023/Feb 16|Added more Dungeon Journals, including The Follower, featuring '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} {{History|0.19|[[File:Dr. Emmett.png|26px]] Added '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} }}

|x13 = -101.5 |y13 = 79.12 |z13 = -175.5 }} '''Elle''' is an [[NPC]] on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there. == Quests == '''Elle''' is one of the main [[NPCs]] for the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] for both [[Factions]]. She first appears in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} trying to fight three {{MobSprite|Blaze (Elle's Quest);Blazes}}, after which she tasks the player with bringing her {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=4}}, {{Item|Blaze Ashes|amount=3}} and {{Item|Spectre Dust|amount=2}}. After the player does this, '''Elle''' will start leaving the Stronghold. She will be in front of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} within {{Zone|Dragontail}}, and outside the {{Zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} within {{Zone|Scarleton}}. She will then task the player with speaking to four [[NPCs]] from each [[Faction]], so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. The quest then splits depending on which faction was chosen. '''Elle''' is also required to access the Basic Tier of the [[Kuudra]] fight. '''Rezzus''' was an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Village}} during the [[Raffle of the Century]] event.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" |First interaction during [[Raffle of the Century]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy &bSkyBlock Year [year]&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To celebrate this &5&lEPIC &fmilestone, we are organizing a set of &d&l&oCRAZY &fraffles!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: But first, you need a &bTEAM&f!}}
|-
| class="ct" |Closing interface before joining team
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Oh... did you mean to close that?
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: It's fine, click me again!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Joining a team
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Sweet, the &l[COLOR] &fteam.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: I hear it might be the best one!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Anyway... there are &63 &fkinds of raffles going on.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &6Speed Raffles &fare drawn every &92 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &bDaily Raffles&f, they happen every &624 &fhours.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: &c&lThe Big One&f, which is going to be drawn at the end of &bYear [year]&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To participate, collect &bRaffle Tickets &fand &dslices of cake &fby simply playing &aSkyBlock &fduring the event.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: All tickets you gain are automatically entered into the next raffle of each type.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: When you receive a &dslice of cake&f, it will be a certain &cc&6o&el&ao&9r&f, which corresponds to a certain team.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: There are slices of &cRed Velvet&f, &9Blueberry&f, &eLemon Cheesecake&f, &aMatcha&f, and &dStrawberry Shortcake&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If you take your slice of cake and feed it to a member of that team, you'll both get some &6rewards&f, in addition to &9bonus Raffle Tickets&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Here, I'll give you &b3 Raffle Tickets &fto get you started.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can get more tickets by eating cake and completing &bRaffle Tasks&f. Check out the &6Raffle Box &ffor more info on those!
&6&lREZZUS GIFT! &eYou gained &b+3 Raffle Tickets&e!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Tada!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can click on the &6Raffle Box &fnext to me or in your &aSkyBlock Menu &fto view your event progress.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Oh, one last thing! The team that enters the most tickets into &c&lThe Big One &fwill receive a special &cmemento &fat the end of the event!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Have fun! You can come speak to me again if you have any questions!}}
|-
| class="ct" |Subsequent interactions
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hello again! &dHappy Century Celebration&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: What would you like to know about the event?
&eSelect an option:
&e➜ &b[How do I enter the raffles?]
&e➜ &6[Which team am I on?]
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Selecting {{Rmt|&b[How do I enter the raffles?]}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: To enter a &6raffle&f, you need to collect &bRaffle Tickets&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You will gain tickets just for &ebeing online &fduring the event&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: However, you will gain a bit more if you're actively playing, especially from doing &bRaffle Tasks&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Tickets are not physical items, so don't worry about losing them!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Each time you find a &bticket&f, it will be entered into &lEVERY&f upcoming raffle.
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Selecting {{Rmt|&6[Which team am I on?]}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: For this event, you are on the &7&l[COLOR]&f team!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Which means more cake for the rest of us!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Missing the Raffle of the Century
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hi!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: There was a big event in celebration of the &bSkyBlock Year [year]&f.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: It looks like you missed it, but maybe you'll catch the next event!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Before {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 300}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) &bSkyBlock Year 300&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: We're organizing a huge raffle!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Come talk to me once the event starts!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |After the [[Century Celebration]]s of {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 300}}, {{Aqua|400}} and {{Aqua|500}}
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hi!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: The &dCentury Celebration &fevent is over, but you can still interact with the &6Raffle Box &fto claim rewards you might have missed.
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: See you next time!
}}
|-
| class="ct" |Before {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 500}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) &bSkyBlock Year 500&f!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: As part of the &dCentury Celebration&f, we're organizing a &c&lhuge &fraffle!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Come talk to me once the event starts!}}
|-
| class="ct" |During {{Aqua|SkyBlock Year 500}} [[Raffle of the Century]], on a {{Gamemode|Bingo}} Profile
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Hey there!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: You cannot claim prizes or even view the raffle box on bingo, but you can earn tickets!
&e[NPC] &aRezzus&f: Unsurprisingly, you've been assigned to the &7&l[COLOR]&f &rteam!
&7&oYou will now be able to earn tickets on this bingo profile.
}}
|}

They are [[Chief Scorn]]'s son and a key figure in the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline#Barbarian|Barbarian Faction questline]]. == Quest == '''Ugo''' is found by the player and [[Elle]] in a little cave in the {{zone|Burning Desert}} in the form of a pig. The player must feed them {{Item|Sulphur|amount=1}} and escort Ugo and [[Elle]] to the {{zone|Chief's Hut}}. Doing so will accept the player into the [[Barbarian Faction]]. '''Ugo''' and [[Elle]] will then ask the player to steal the Research from the {{NPCSprite|Dean}} in the {{zone|Cathedral}}. After successfully doing so, the player will gain {{Reputation|Barbarian|+100}}, and Ugo will ask the player to complete a Test of Force, a Test of Stamina and a Test of Mastery, with a minimum rating of {{Yellow|C}}. Finally, '''Ugo''' will ask the player to kill a {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} and a {{MobSprite|Magma Cube Boss}}. Doing so will grant {{Reputation|Barbarian|+150}}, plus an additional 20 for killing the boss the first time that day. The player will meet '''Ugo''' again after they complete [[Gris]]'s Quest, where they will meet Ugo, Elle and [[Captain Ahone]] outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} to defeat [[Kuudra]]. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable centertext" !Condition !Dialogue |- | Start of the [[Barbarian Faction]] quest

My father is going to KILL ME!! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Let's not exaggerate. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You don't understand, my father is the &cChief&f! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were not exaggerating. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Please help me, I have to present myself to him. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Of course. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I will shoulder you to the &cChief's Hut&f. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: &7&f make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there. }} |- |Whilst {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} Scolds '''Ugo''' |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, where have you been? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou had ONE job! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Well- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAnd you two, what are your names? Not too bad? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm sorry you had to go through this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I don't really have a choice. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The &cTown Board &fmissions get harder the higher your Reputation gets. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The first one requires eliminating a &cMage Outlaw&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The one we need to eliminate is in the &cCourtyard&f, it's on the outskirts of &5Scarleton&f, towards the north. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of &5Scarleton&f, just outside of the city.}} |- | After killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You dealt with it? (tasks completed) |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Time to focus on myself.}} |- |Meeting outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life! &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside. }} |- | class="ct" | Right after defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. You are late to your training. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7 &f&lI am in your debt. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures. }} |} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside.
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight!

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster?

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7<player>&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Is anyone going to thank me?
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, where have you been?

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou had ONE job!
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Well-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAnd you two, what are your names?

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThank you for saving my rascal of a son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAre you looking to join our ranks?

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: No but-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lPerfect!
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction!
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lIf you betray us you'll die.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I can't-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough talking!
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, go back out there and finish the job!

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: But-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort them out of my Hut!
}}

{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lNewest member of the Faction!
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThe entire stash of Sulphur of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHe might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI implore you. Please assist Ugo in this operation.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI don't know what I would do without my son. My only son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThey have followed the traces of the Sulphur all the way to the Forgotten Skull in the North.
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7<player> &f&lI am in your debt.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures.
}}

{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &61&f meeting of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Attend two more and I'll give you my &3Abiphone Contact&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The master plan.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Right, the master plan. &5Thondin&f, care to update us?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was &5Brarnas&f! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You said you never even saw the plates.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And I didn't! But &5Brarnas&f told me about it.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: No I didn't.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Anyways!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Try not to break those too.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cool.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I don't think that would work.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Sure.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Jobs may come and go, but the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f is eternal.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: You are right. I shall be there.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Awesome.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, next point of interest...
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Cat again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cat again. I've got to go.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!}}

§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Ah, §7<Player>§f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: You've now attended §61§f meeting of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Attend two more and I'll give you my §3Abiphone Contact§f.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: The master plan.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Right, the master plan. §5Thondin§f, care to update us?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was §5Brarnas§f! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You said you never even saw the plates.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: And I didn't! But §5Brarnas§f told me about it.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: No I didn't.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Anyways!
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Try not to break those too.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Cool.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: I don't think that would work.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Sure.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Jobs may come and go, but the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f is eternal.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: You are right. I shall be there.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Awesome.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Alright, next point of interest...
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Again?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Cat again?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Cat again. I've got to go.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!

{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &62&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Attend one more and I'll give you my &3Abiphone Contact&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: What is it?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: The sleepover.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Uh-oh.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: We're never having another one again.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Why?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I wonder why. Where do I start?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: We were hungry.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You're not helping.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You don't even know which two people died!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: TWO?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Might be three in a minute.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You deserved that spoiler. And-
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: You can pay for the pizza.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Yes.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Again, &5Thondin&f?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Apologies.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Cat again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Nope, wife.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Oh. That's not good.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in &5Scarleton&f. Thought it was her day off.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Yep.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!}}

{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &63&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys, today I have something ''super urgent'' to discuss.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: What is it, &5Thondin&f?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: There we go.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And how did you reach that conclusion?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And guards, thoughthey serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yup, I sleep in one.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, &5 Thondin&f.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Huh?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: But it ''is'' a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: How can you be so sure?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Because everyone ''calls it'' a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Have you ever seen one turn?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Now that I think about it, no. I've neveer seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Me neither!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The same is true for me.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Don't be silly.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!}}

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You’ve now attended &64&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: What is it, &5Thondin&f?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: There we go.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And how did you reach that conclusion?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And guards, though they serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yup, I sleep in one.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, &5Thondin&f.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Huh?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: But it is a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: How can you be so sure?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Because everyone calls it a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Have you ever seen one turn?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The same is true for me.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Don't be silly.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!

{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside.
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight!

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster?

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.

}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7<player> &f&lI am in your debt.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures.
}}
